title: Trumpet with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell of trumpet -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='18' ry='26' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='13' ry='20' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Bell rim -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='18' ry='26' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- Main tube body -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='50' height='12' rx='5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='50' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFE082'/>

  <!-- Valves casing -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='14' height='26' rx='4' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='14' height='10' rx='4' fill='#FFD700'/>

  <!-- Valve buttons -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <rect x='46' y='17' width='3' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <rect x='52' y='20' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#F5F5F5'/>

  <!-- Valve caps -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='17' r='3' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='14' r='3' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='17' r='3' fill='#B0BEC5'/>

  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='12' y='47' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <rect x='8' y='45' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#E6A800'/>

  <!-- Tuning slide -->
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='6' height='22' rx='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='56' y='52' width='6' height='22' rx='3' fill='#E6A800'/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the tube -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#5C4033'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#5C4033'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='30.8' cy='47.3' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='47.3' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 28 52 Q 33 56 38 52' stroke='#5C4033' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='51' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='51' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Musical notes floating -->
  <g fill='#FFE082'>
    <ellipse cx='85' cy='25' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='88' y='15' width='1.8' height='10' rx='0.9'/>
    <ellipse cx='92' cy='22' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='95' y='12' width='1.8' height='10' rx='0.9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'>
    <path d='M 15 25 L 16 28 L 19 29 L 16 30 L 15 33 L 14 30 L 11 29 L 14 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M 70 18 L 70.8 20 L 73 20.8 L 70.8 21.6 L 70 24 L 69.2 21.6 L 67 20.8 L 69.2 20 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
